title: Outcome event payload (W8)
description: The learner results of one delivery, as aggregates only: how many learners were assessed, the delivery's mean score, the cohort baseline and, when collected, the mean feedback rating and the median across comparable deliveries. No learner identity, score or comment belongs here, ever: additionalProperties is false so an import that carries one is refused, not stored. Written by `teachermodel import-outcomes` from an outcome-import@1 file.

delivery_ref.description: The delivery id or session reference, not a person's name

score.description: Mean performance-task score of the learners assessed; null below rules.quality.min_learners_for_metric learners assessed (dropped at import, decision 0015)

baseline.description: The cohort baseline on the same scale

feedback.description: Mean feedback rating for the delivery; null below rules.quality.min_learners_for_metric learners assessed

source.description: The export the summary came from (outcome-import `source`)
